title: Going deeper: Check the meaning
categoryContext: Growing independence at home, school and online
stageSummary: Use curiosity to find the barrier, perspective or missing information before deciding the response.
pressureLine: Don't use that tone with me.
possibleWeather: Older children may hear pressure as mistrust, public judgement or loss of agency. Make the reason, choice and responsibility visible.
practice: ask what the speaker meant and name the impact you noticed
principle: Separate intent, impact and the communication standard.
nextSentence: Respect can be addressed directly. Tell me what is getting in the way, then we can ask what the speaker meant and name the impact you noticed.
keyLearning: Separate intent, impact and the communication standard.
curriculum: Australian Curriculum v9.0 - Personal and Social capability: Social awareness
Australian Curriculum v9.0 HPE - Interacting with others
EYLF V2.0 - Outcome 5: Children are effective communicators
